# Xisaabaati

## What is Xisaabaati?
Xisaabaati is a simple mobile-first accounting and profit-tracking application built specifically for small merchants in Somalia and the Somali diaspora worldwide.

## Core Promise
"Know your business profit quickly and clearly." — in Somali, Arabic, and English.
The Somali headline: "Ma ogtahay inta aad maanta faa'iidday?" (Do you know how much you profited today?)

## Who Uses It
Small shop owners, restaurant operators, pharmacy owners, clothing stores, and import/export merchants in:
- Mogadishu (Muqdisho), Somalia
- Hargeisa (Hargeysa), Somaliland
- Bosaso (Boosaaso), Puntland
- Kismayo (Kismaayo), Jubaland
- Galkayo (Galkacyo), Mudug
- Berbera, Somaliland
- Burco, Somaliland
- Somali diaspora (US, UK, UAE, Canada, Finland, Sweden, Kenya, Ethiopia)

## Key Features
- Real-time profit calculation after every sale
- Sales recording (product, price, quantity — 10 seconds per sale)
- Daily expense tracking (fuel, rent, stock purchases)
- Customer management with debt tracking
- Weekly and monthly profit reports
- Offline-first (works without internet)
- Local payment methods: EVC Plus, Zaad, Sahal, Western Union (no credit card needed)
- Multi-language: Somali (default), Arabic, English

## Pricing
- Free: 20 sales/month — $0
- Starter: Unlimited sales — $9/month ($6.30/month billed annually)
- Basic: Invoices + advanced reports — $19/month ($13.30/month billed annually)
- Pro: Multi-user + export + dedicated manager — $39/month ($27.30/month billed annually)

## Technology
- React 18 + Vite SPA
- Firebase Authentication + Firestore (real-time)
- Deployed on Vercel (www.xisaabaati.com)
- Progressive Web App — installable on iOS and Android

## Languages
- Somali (so) — PRIMARY language, default
- Arabic (ar) — secondary
- English (en) — secondary

## Contact
- Email: hello@xisaabaati.com

- Website: https://www.xisaabaati.com

## Mission
To give every Somali merchant — from Mogadishu's Bakaaraha market to Hargeisa's Waaheen market — the same financial clarity that large businesses have, in their own language, on their phone, offline.
